description: For an ideal I, the class of a subset A is one exactly when the complement of A belongs to I.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.quotient_one_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (I : Order.Ideal (Set α)) (A : Set α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.mk I A = ⊤ ↔ Aᶜ ∈ I
